contract.citation_mode_source_only: Cite by source rather than by page, as declared in the metadata master. Slide fields are always null. Page markers may still be present (50 of 71) and are source-derived: 44 appear verbatim in the chunk's own text, 6 are inherited from a page marker earlier in the same document. None are fabricated.
contract.note: citation_mode and provenance_status are independent fields and must not be conflated.
contract.provenance_status_source_only: No resolvable citation anchor. All page and slide fields are null (verified across all 539).
